films.title: The Lost Sprout
films.logline: When the youngest Knight follows a too-friendly stranger toward a secret door, the Knights race across the realm — and Sprout learns that calling for help is the bravest move of all.
lessons: A stranger offering a gift and asking you to keep it secret is the warning sign.
If a new friend wants to take you somewhere private — stop.
Being rushed is a red flag.
Sounding certain is not the same as being right — check before you act.
Calling for help is the brave move. You are never in trouble for asking.
films.talkPrompt: Ask at dinner: “If someone online gave you something and asked you to keep it a secret from me, what would you do?”
